text: 创业板指涨超1%，沪指涨0.17%，深成指涨0.73%，玻璃基板、创新药、液冷服务器、半导体等方向领涨，沪深京三市上涨个股近2600只。
text_en: ChiNext Index rose over 1%, Shanghai Composite rose 0.17%, Shenzhen Component rose 0.73%, with glass substrate, innovative drugs, liquid cooling servers, and semiconductors leading gains, and nearly 2,600 stocks rising across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets.
